about_the_game: In Slime With A Gun, you play as a slime who will explore and shoot your way out of procedurally generate dungeons filled with dangerous enemies, finding a variety of different bullets to equip in your Magazine. Use powerful Anvils that merge bullets together, combining their effects in infinite combinations. Defeat bosses at the end of each level to travel back in time, encountering new and stronger enemies with each Era. Relics unlock unique abilities, so choose wisely! Collect Bones and DNA from fallen enemies to buy upgrades that help you reach further each run. Also wear silly hats!

short_description: Slime With A Gun is a fast-paced 2D top-down roguelike shooter where you control a slime with a powerful gun! Craft and merge bullets to create unique, devastating projectiles as you step through time, facing a variety of enemies. Will you survive the chaos and master the art of bullet crafting?
